description: The reader's windows: only the app commands the UI calls (open a document through the dialog, unlock it, its pages, dropping tiles it no longer wants, closing it, taking the files the OS asked it to open before it was ready, the recent files by id and the app's preferences) and listening for the open requests' events, the engine's restart and failure events and the events of a file that changed on disk. core:default is not granted; each core permission is named (ADR 0008 §6).
